options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Choose which goal should count as completing your game. For a first
playthrough, we recommend *Main Quest 7* which marks the end of the
original Outward story line with one of the *Peacemaker* quests or the
*A House Divided* quest.
- **Main Quest N:** Complete the *n*-th main quest in Outward: Definitive
Edition. *Main quest 7* is the end of the original story line, and *Main
quest 12* is the end of the Definitive Edition story line. These could be
different quests depending on which faction you choose, but all factions
have the same number of quests.
- **Blood Under the Sun Quest:** Complete the parallel quest *Blood Under
the Sun* by finding the culprit behind the assassination of Prince Jaden.
- **Purifier Quest:** Complete the parallel quest *Purifier* by
investigating rumors of trouble in the *Hallowed Marsh*.
- **Vendavel Quest:** Complete the parallel quest *Vendavel Quest* by
preventing the destruction of *Cierzo*.
- **Rust and Vengeance:** Complete the parallel quest *Rust and Vengeance*
by foiling the *Rust Lich*'s plans to destroy Harmattan.
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez quel objectif devrait compter comme compléter votre jeu. Pour une première lecture, nous recommandons *Main Quest 7* qui marque la fin de l'histoire originale Outward avec l'une des quêtes *Peacemaker* ou la quête *A House Divided*.
- **Main Quest N:** Terminez la quête principale *n*-th dans Outward: Definitive Edition. * La quête principale 7* est la fin de la ligne d'histoire originale, et la quête principale 12* est la fin de la ligne d'histoire de l'édition définitive. Ces quêtes pourraient être différentes selon la faction que vous choisissez, mais toutes les factions ont le même nombre de quêtes.
- ** Blood Under the Sun Quest :** Compléter la quête parallèle * Blood Under the Sun* en trouvant le coupable derrière l'assassinat du prince Jaden.
- **Purifier Quest:** Terminez la quête parallèle *Purifier* en enquêtant sur les rumeurs d'ennuis dans le *Hallowed Marsh*.
- **Vendavel Quest:** Terminez la quête parallèle *Vendavel Quest* en empêchant la destruction de *Cierzo*.
- **Rust and Vengeance:** Terminez la quête parallèle *Rust et Vengeance* en déjouant les plans du *Rust Lich* pour détruire Harmattan.

options.name: SkillSanity
options.doc:
Randomize the selection provided by skill trainers.
- **Vanilla:** Trainers provide the same selection as in the base game.
- **Tier One Only:** Tier one skills are added to the general item pool.
- **Full:** All skills are added to the general item pool.

options.name: Wind Alter checks
options.doc:
Make the Cabal of Wind Altars for each region location checks, and add their
corresponding boons to the item pool.
options.doc_fr: Faites la Cabale des autels à vent pour chaque région vérification de l'emplacement, et ajoutez leurs seins correspondants à la piscine de l'article.

options.name: Number of Available Breakthough Points
options.doc:
Set the number of available breakthrough points.
A value of 11 means that all skill trainer skills are potentially available.

options.name: Breakthough Point checks
options.doc:
Add breakthough points to the item pool, as well as additional checks for
interacting with each skill trainer.
options.doc_fr: Ajoutez des points de casse-tête au pool d'articles, ainsi que des vérifications supplémentaires pour interagir avec chaque formateur.
